page.overview:
What is All Faiths Altar?

The All Faiths Altar was a shrine in the city of Loudwater in the Delimbiyr Vale in the mid-to-late 14 century DR. It was open to worshipers of all non-evil faiths (with Bane, Cyric, Malar, and such excluded).

Poor travelers sometimes slept in the shrine's forechancel, usually when the weather was bad. However, pilgrims and wandering priests were permitted to stay no more than a tenday.
